ORNL/LTR-2025/4149 A North Carolina Retrospective: Major Outage Event Trends & Hurricane Helene The impacts of Hurricane Helene in September of 2024 showed magnifying effects on the number of major power outages reported both during and after the catastrophic weather event. The affected areas on the western edge of 2022 North Carolina, particularly Buncombe County (Asheville), endured a disproportionate number of outage impacts than surrounding counties atop the Piedmont Plateau. In 2024, each of the counties with the highest frequency of major outage events received at least one category 2023 of FEMA Disaster Declaration following Hurricane Helene.
